node.statement: Fix arbitrary W_RF, S, Delta-prime, Delta, n, X, Y as quantified in node 1 and assume 0 <= eta <= rho_2. By def-routef-raw-factor-setting and lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, rho_2=min{rho_prod,rho_Delta-prime,rho_Delta}, rho_prod=rho_T, rho_T <= 1/[4(1+C_V)], and C_theta,C_V,C_T,C_Delta-prime,C_Delta are nonnegative. Hence eta <= rho_prod=rho_T, eta <= rho_Delta-prime, eta <= rho_Delta, and C_V*eta <= 1/4.
